component.name: openHLSW
component.summary: Game server browser and RCON admin tool

description.p: openHLSW is a free remake of HLSW: a game server browser and RCON admin tool for Source (SRCDS, CS2) and Half-Life 1 (HLDS) servers that also queries GameSpy, Quake, Unreal, Minecraft, TeamSpeak and many other game and voice servers.
